# DexLadder
> Free, keyless gateway to Web3: live on-chain markets, AMM/DeFi mechanics, perpetuals,
> strategy bots, an on-chain explorer and a fork sandbox for the user's own contracts.
> No account, no wallet connection, no key input, no real money at risk. All state is stored
> on the user's own device.

## Facts
- Product: DexLadder — a keyless Web3 gateway; web app, iOS app, Android app
- Cost: free; no paid tier, no ads, no affiliate exchange links, no token
- Account: none required — no email, no password, no KYC, no wallet connection
- Money: simulated only. No deposits, no withdrawals, no custody, no real orders
- Data: live market prices; balances, fills, journal and tax ledger computed on-device
- Modules: trading terminal, markets screener, portfolio and journal, academy,
  on-chain explorer, P2P bazaar, DeFi liquidity desk, strategy bots, historical replay,
  multi-jurisdiction tax ledger
- Execution model: fills charged spread, venue fees and real price impact
  (constant-product and concentrated-liquidity arithmetic), never mid-price fills
- Tax jurisdictions modelled: India, United States, Germany, United Arab Emirates
- Contact: dexladder@gmail.com
